data.one_liner: A Dart implementation of an HTML5 parser for strings and bytes.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs for parsing and manipulating HTML content outside the browser. It parses HTML strings or byte lists into a document object model and supports document fragments and low-level tokenization control.
use_when: You need to parse HTML content inside a Dart backend or command-line tool
You want to manipulate or query HTML elements outside of a browser environment
avoid_when: You are working entirely within a Flutter UI and can use built-in web views
You only need to parse simple XML documents where an XML parser would suffice
strengths: Fully-featured HTML5 parser ported from Python's html5lib
Supports parsing document fragments as well as full documents
weaknesses: Dropped support for encodings other than UTF-8 and ASCII

alternatives.name: xml
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick xml if you are parsing strict XML documents rather than HTML5.
